'''Rayamal 22''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] where [[Szark]] lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set" />

==Behind the scenes==
'''Rayamal 22''' was introduced in the starter set of the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] tactical miniatures [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]''.
